caption: The four threads run at the same time for 40 ms each, but creating them (5 ms) and merging their partial sums (5 ms) sit outside that parallel stretch, so the job ends at 50 ms, not 40 ms. The two short bars are the overhead that turns an ideal 4× into a real 3.2×.

spec.aria: A timeline in milliseconds: 5 ms to create four threads, four threads each adding 2,000,000 numbers side by side from 5 ms to 45 ms, then 5 ms to merge the four partial sums, finishing at 50 ms.
